policy: Ordinary nonlegendary M21 black component source only. Legendary crowns, colored artifacts, planeswalkers, lands and other sets remain outside this fit.
Shared pigment fit, never a per-card rendering adjustment. Per-scan affine transforms are comparison data only. Fixed ink-free rail windows exclude the black art keyline.
Complete native card replay verifies scope and preserves central art/paper. It is not full-card accuracy certification: supplied printing text may fall back to Oracle.
All reference cohorts are reused development data. The original shared candidate is unchanged after boundary normalization; reserved target colors do not refit the curve.
39 of 40 affected cards have accepted scan poses and color metrics. Liliana’s Scorn remains open; no whole-set completion claim.

Both the prior selector and prior profile table are bundled from the baseline commit.
